headline: Iran foreign minister denies involvement in drone attack that k!lled two in Kuwait
label: BREAKING
caption:
Tehran denies any role in a deadly drone attack on Kuwait that k!lled two Italian nationals. 🇮🇷

According to Iran's Foreign Ministry, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi rejected claims that Tehran was behind the strike during a phone call with his Kuwaiti counterpart.

The attack also left two other people injured.

Iran stated it is willing to take part in an investigation into the incident according to the foreign ministry.
